name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. This balances visibility for keyboard users with modern display clarity, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA while avoiding the harshness of a 7:1 ring at 3px. The trade-off is slightly less crisp focus for users with perfect vision, but it ensures readability for those with mild visual impairments and works better on mobile screens.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 6:1 still risks blending into busy backgrounds on mobile—use a 5px ring at 7:1 instead. That keeps the focus ring crisp for all users, including those with low vision, without sacrificing touch precision. Test it on a high-contrast mobile background to settle the argument.
